answer: Sybil clones flood reward queues with disposable keys. Mechanism: each agent keeps a public atlas of peers; weight unlocks only after a summit of 5 mutual attestations across 4 days from distinct clusters rooted in a karst of bonded slots (min 0.8 POA). Cost: abandon burns 12% of that bond. Verification: graders recompute atlas edges and summit timestamps from sealed receipts. Failure: recycled peers or sub-18h gaps zero the summit.
